record.paper_title: Open problems, questions and challenges in finite-dimensional integrable systems
record.original_question: Does there exist a non-conformally flat metric on the sphere Sn, n > 2, whose geodesic flow is maximally superintegrable (in the class of integrals which are polynomial in momenta)?

evidence.quote: Question 3.11. Does there exist a non-conformally flat metric on the sphere Sn, n > 2, whose geodesic flow is maximally superintegrable (in the class of integrals which are polynomial in momenta)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n>2$ and consider the $n$-sphere $S^n$ equipped with a smooth Riemannian metric $g$. The geodesic flow of $g$ is the Hamiltonian flow on $T^*S^n$ generated by the Hamiltonian $H(x,p)=\tfrac12 g^{ij}(x)p_ip_j$. A function $F\colon T^*S^n\to\mathbb{R}$ that is polynomial in the fiber variables $p$ is called a polynomial-in-momenta integral if $\{F,H\}=0$, where $\{\cdot,\cdot\}$ is the canonical Poisson bracket. The geodesic flow is called maximally superintegrable (in the class of polynomial-in-momenta integrals) if there exist $2n-1$ functions $F_1=H,F_2,\dots,F_{2n-1}$ on $T^*S^n$, each polynomial in the momenta, that Poisson-commute with $H$ and are functionally independent on an open dense subset of $T^*S^n$.

A Riemannian metric $g$ on $S^n$ is said to be conformally flat if every point has a neighborhood on which $g$ is conformal to the Euclidean metric.

Question: Does there exist a non-conformally-flat Riemannian metric on $S^n$ (for some $n>2$) whose geodesic flow is maximally superintegrable in the class of integrals polynomial in the momenta?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent literature on superintegrable geodesic flows on spheres focuses on the 2-dimensional case (e.g., constructions of nonconstant-curvature superintegrable metrics on S^2 with higher-degree polynomial integrals, and resolutions of related Bolsinov–Kozlov–Fomenko conjectures in dimension 2). Examples of maximally superintegrable systems on n-dimensional spaces of nonconstant curvature exist for open domains, but no construction of a non-conformally-flat maximally superintegrable metric on S^n with n>2 has been reported. The question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Real Analyticity of 2-Dimensional Superintegrable Metrics and Solution of Two Bolsinov–Kozlov–Fomenko Conjectures
status_evidence.snippet: Resolves conjectures in dimension 2 about superintegrable metrics.
status_evidence.claim: Recent progress concerns the 2D case; higher-dimensional sphere question is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: A maximally superintegrable system on an n-dimensional space of nonconstant curvature
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs maximally superintegrable Hamiltonian on an n-dimensional space of nonconstant (but conformally flat) curvature.
status_evidence.claim: Known n-dimensional examples are on conformally flat spaces, not on S^n with non-conformally-flat metric.

status_evidence.title: Open Problems, Questions, and Challenges in Finite-Dimensional Integrable Systems
status_evidence.snippet: Lists the question among open problems.
